text:
Leo Kim: Heads up — Orbit Labs onboarding is blocked, trial org `orbit-93` started yesterday and embeds ingest is failing with 403s. Support dug in and sees an IAM role mismatch during provisioning. Renewal conversation is next Tue; escalating to CS + enablement for priority handling. @Maya Rao @Aisha Patel please take lead.

Maya Rao: On it. Can you drop the support ticket link and the immediate logs? I'll set a 30m sync with Orbit and Solutions for today. Is generation impacted or just ingest/embeds?

Leo Kim: Only ingest/upload for embeddings. Generation endpoints are green. Support ticket #24567. Relevant log snippet: ```PUT /v1/ingest 403 AccessDenied s3.amazonaws.com role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-orbit```

Aisha Patel: I can run the SSO/perm checklist. Proposed quick comm plan: 1) Immediate outreach to Orbit CSM + technical DM; 2) Short-term workaround: enable proxied upload through our managed bucket (opt-in) scoped to eu-west-1 if they need EU residency; 3) Target fix within 48h; 4) CS to own renewal messaging and follow-up. Thoughts?

Chris Nguyen: I can implement the proxy patch and ship a short-lived feature flag. Need `embed_proxy` enabled for org `orbit-93`. @eng-infra / @deploy-bot can you expedite? I can scope a PR for the patch in the next 2 hours.

Maya Rao: Owners: Support (Leo) — triage & update ticket, Solutions (Chris) — proxy patch + PR, CS (Maya) — customer comms + renewal alignment, Aisha — perms checklist & doc fixes. I'll schedule sync for today 3:00 PM PT and invite Hannah Li (hannah@orbitlabs.com). We need an FAQ: what happened, temp workaround, timeline.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Feature flag request received for `embed_proxy` on `orbit-93` — pending approval by eng-infra. ETA ~2h.

Leo Kim: Customer notes — Hannah is worried about data residency and wants in-app updates. She asked for weekly status digests until resolved. Also flagged potential procurement conversation if SLA impact.

Aisha Patel: Filing a doc ticket for onboarding guide clarity — step "connect storage" is ambiguous for customers using S3 roles. Ticket: CS-472. We'll update the quickstart to show role ARNs and permission scope.

Chris Nguyen: I'll route proxy to eu-west-1 and post the PR link here when ready. Quick patch summary: set proxy bucket region per org metadata, add flag guard `embed_proxy`, fallback to direct ingest if disabled.

Maya Rao: After today's sync I'll push a concise comms email to renewals and mark Orbit as `high-risk` in Gainsight. Also prepping a short troubleshooting playbook so Support can escalate faster if similar popups appear.

Leo Kim: Adding link to support ticket and incident notes in case anyone needs full timeline: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CSUP-24567 (support thread appended). I'll update this thread after the sync.

Chris Nguyen: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/orbit-proxy/pull/512 — patch ready, awaiting flag.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Feature flag `embed_proxy` for `orbit-93` enabled.

Maya Rao: Great — meeting scheduled. I'll share the draft customer email here post-meeting. Keeping this thread as single source-of-truth. :+1:

Aisha Patel: Captured feedback from Orbit: add explicit S3 role examples and a small troubleshooting flow. Will attach doc diff to CS-472 when ready.

Leo Kim: Thanks team. Will close the support loop once CS confirms customer outreach and proxy is live.

Maya Rao: Drafted comms (will paste after sync): short apology, what we changed, mitigation (proxy + timeline), ask for confirmation that EU residency is OK. Will cc renewals.

Chris Nguyen: Patch deployed to canary for orbit-93, monitoring telemetry. Will flag in this thread if any regression.

Maya Rao: :thumbsup: everyone — follow-ups: Chris posts final deploy note, Aisha updates docs, Leo updates ticket. We'll reconvene if anything changes.
